description: Update one saved build by ID: rename it, edit notes, patch its portable spec, or deliberately replace its full spec/webState. Uploaded-media partnerships support profile.partnership for a shared Second Identity and texts.perAd/perAdset sponsor overrides, including both IDs null for No Partner. These builds launch through the CLI and MCP and hydrate their identities in the web uploader. Approval is rechecked at preview and launch. Prefer specPatch for content edits: omitted fields survive and nested text entries merge field-by-field, so changing headlines does not clear link, displayUrl, CTA, URL tags, or AI disclosure. Uploaded-media texts.perAd keys are file names or media:<uploadId>; a file name that two uploads share is refused, so rename one or use media:<uploadId>. CTA fields use Meta enum values such as SHOP_NOW. Standard ads normalize human labels such as Shop Now; imported partnership posts require the enum and do not normalize labels. specPatch requires the revision from ads_get_build as expectedRevision. Send edits to a build one at a time, never in parallel. Changes to spec, webState, mediaItems or uploadBatchId bump the revision. A rename or notes-only update does not bump it. Batch many ad edits into one specPatch where you can. On "Build changed since it was read" (HTTP 409), call ads_get_build again and retry with its current revision as expectedRevision. Use spec only for a full rewrite because it replaces the whole portable spec. Do not construct webState by hand; only round-trip an unchanged webState previously read from the build. When only portable spec changes, the web uploader regenerates webState on next resume. Setting a name promotes an autosaved build to a kept, named build. Returns updated metadata only; call ads_get_build again to read the stored state. Confirm that the update was saved; an open uploader tab picks it up automatically. Share the build url only when the user asks for it or says the tab is closed. Do not surface webStateStale or launchable/launchBlockers unless the user asked about launching from the CLI/MCP: webStateStale:true after a spec edit is normal and clears itself when the web uploader next opens the build, and launchable only describes headless ads_create launches - it never prevents opening, editing, or launching the build in the web uploader. Save and update return display.totalAdSets, display.totalAds and the ads in each ad set as the web uploader renders them. Compare these with preview totals before creating. If display.complete is false, read its reason before comparing. Fields in display.inheritedFromSource.fields come from the source ad or preset. With inheritedFromSource.loadedAt they show its values; otherwise they are null (see reason), so read them from ads_preview. Existing destinations show adSetId and campaignId; names show when they are the ad set or campaign of the source ad. Treat any other mismatch for a complete display as a bug and call ads_report_issue with buildId, expected and actual. Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. With campaign.id alone, new ad sets are created. copyFromAd with no campaign or adSet creates a new paused campaign and ad set from the template settings. Cross-campaign create/preview is available only for direct agent requests. Saved builds and Agent Inbox launches must use the template ad's campaign or a new campaign; to save a build for another existing campaign, copy from an ad in that campaign (campaign.id + adSet.id picks one). Existing stored cross-campaign builds can still launch, but cannot be re-saved. The same goes for ad sets: a saved build that names an existing ad set must name the template ad's own ad set, or use a new ad set; to post into another existing ad set, copy from an ad in that ad set or launch directly without saving a build. A stored build that names another ad set can still launch from the CLI and MCP, but must be changed in the uploader before it launches there.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by ads_get_build. Required with specPatch and recommended for every update; the update fails instead of overwriting a newer revision.

name.description: New build name. Setting a name marks the build as manually saved, so it stops rotating out with autosaves.

notes.description: Free-form notes stored on the build.

spec.description: Replacement portable spec (the launch configuration used by ads_create with buildId). Send the FULL updated spec object, not a partial diff. Set to null to clear it.

specPatch.description: Preferred for content edits. Field-aware merge patch applied to the stored portable spec: omitted fields survive, nested objects (including individual texts.perAd/perAdset entries) merge, supplied arrays replace, and null removes a field. Requires expectedRevision. Computed launchability metadata cannot be patched.

webState.description: Opaque web uploader session snapshot. Do not construct this object by hand. Only send it when round-tripping a webState previously read from the build without changing its structure. For content changes, update spec only; the web uploader regenerates webState on its next resume.

name: ads_update_build
title: Update Saved Build
